texts.en: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the [contact_country.GetName]. Although investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate, faster progress could be made once communications were opened with the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our [Root.GetResearchers] were able to study their technology, which has helped us uncover several novel new approaches to our own research problems.
